## Task
Do A and B name the same business concept (the same real-world thing, so the classes model one concept under different names)? Concepts that merely share attributes such as an id or a date are not the same.

### A
concept: Hive
where: InspectionRepository (uses), src/persistence/repositories.ts, component persistence
code:
=====SOURCE-BEGIN
findByHive(hiveId: string): Inspection[] {
=====SOURCE-END=====

=====SOURCE-END=====

response.rationale: A is the Hive itself. InspectionRepository looks up inspections by a hive id (`findByHive(hiveId: string): Inspection[] {`). B is a Hive Scale, a separate weighing device. It has its own identity, a serialNumber, and it points to a hive through hiveId (`return this.scales.save({ serialNumber, hiveId, ownerId, phoneNumber });`). The graph backs this up: ScaleService injects HiveRepository and also calls ScaleRepository, so hives and scales are stored in separate repositories. A scale linked to a hive is a different real-world thing from the hive, not another name for it.
